svg.text: Requests tab – redesign proposal (v2: Open on top, Active below)
One page, two sections: what needs a decision stays pinned on top, running grants and full repo access sit directly below. History is a collapsed section at the end.
ⓘ Quotes are the assistant's words, not checked
“I need the invoice layout to build the PDF export.”
“Deploy the new checkout build to the staging server.”
“Push the updated API docs to a branch.”
“The checkout PR is reviewed and CI is green.”
New requests appear here and as a notification

A Open requests are pinned on top in a tinted block: compact cards (title, chips, one-line quote, buttons on the same row), time left per card, one hint for all quotes in the section header instead of “(unchecked)” on every card.

B Active sits directly below with one row design for git grants, full repo access and SSH grants: badge, sandbox chip, meta, remaining-time bar, Extend and Revoke. Full repo access gets the stronger badge. The section header has the button to grant it.
C With nothing open the block shrinks to one calm line and Active moves up; History can be expanded in place. D History is a collapsed section with a filter, one line per entry (reason on click).
